source: Project: Self v2.3 via build spec v1.1, Appendix I

rows.title: Wake + morning prep
rows.rule: 500 ml water, daylight, breakfast and lunch prep; no morning study requirement yet.

rows.title: Office
rows.rule: Lunch around 13:30. Stand/walk periodically; do not use office equipment for personal project work.

rows.title: Return + snack / change
rows.rule: Change first; small pre-workout snack and water.

rows.title: Gym (3 sessions/week)
rows.rule: As per the separately reviewed training plan. Tue/Thu can be a short walk.

rows.title: Return, shower, dinner
rows.rule: Eat and reset. Do not open a long scrolling session.

rows.title: DSA
rows.rule: One problem/review with the four-pass method; log one mistake.

rows.title: DDIA / design
rows.rule: About 7 pages plus a three-line note.

rows.title: Build
rows.rule: 15 minutes: one commit, one doc line or one failing test fixed.

rows.title: Close day
rows.rule: Tracker, tomorrow target, breakfast/lunch prep. Screens off; lights out by 23:15 target.

rows.title: Morning prep + DSA attempt
rows.rule: 10 min mobility only if already cleared; 30 min unaided DSA attempt. Rewrite/log moves to evening.

rows.title: Gym (4-day split)
rows.rule: Use the split in the Daily Operating Schedule; clinician/physio clearance controls lower-body activity.

rows.title: DSA rewrite + log
rows.rule: Close solution, re-code in C#, record pattern and bug.

rows.title: DDIA / design
rows.rule: 7-10 pages or a focused design note.

rows.title: Build track
rows.rule: One small committed output. Lights out target around 23:00.

rows.title: Wake
rows.rule: 500 ml water and daylight. Keep bedtime early enough for at least 7 hours of sleep.

rows.title: DSA
rows.rule: Protected C# practice: attempt, unstick, rewrite, log. Default DSA slot from Week 9.

rows.title: Office
rows.rule: Normal workday; hourly movement breaks where practical.

rows.title: Gym / training
rows.rule: Fixed training anchor. Clinical clearance controls exercise choice.

rows.title: Dinner / recovery
rows.rule: Shower, dinner and recovery. Avoid pushing study into sleep time.

rows.title: DDIA / system design
rows.rule: Stable: about 20 min + a short note. After the book, a design drill or ADR defence.

rows.title: Main track
rows.rule: Phase 1: React / MEAI / MAF; Phase 2: flagship; Phase 3: scale/eval; Phase 4: interviews. Stable: 45 min on 3 evenings.

rows.title: Close / shutdown
rows.rule: Tracker, tomorrow targets, prep and sleep routine.

rows.title: DDIA / system design (stretch)
rows.rule: Stretch: about 40 min / 7-10 pages. Only when rested.

rows.title: Main track (stretch)
rows.rule: Stretch block; the stable version is the default.

rows.title: Close / shutdown (stretch)
rows.rule: Stretch only when rested.
